rules.sentence: Brugada syndrome and short QT syndrome: In the management of ventricular arrhythmias associated with Brugada syndrome and short QT syndrome, the American Heart Association/American College of Cardiology/Heart Rhythm Society (AHA/ACC/HRS) guidelines recommend administering an IV loading dose of 800 mg in 50 mL at a rate of 50 mg/min.[6]
